field_id.description: Unique annual field identifier (Danish: Marknr)
field_id.notes: Identifier is only unique for the current year; use field_uuid for tracking the same physical field across different years.

area_ha.description: The officially registered field area in hectares (Danish: IMK_areal)
area_ha.notes: This is the source-of-truth area used for official EU subsidy calculations.

cvr_number.description: Danish Central Business Register (CVR) 8-digit identifier for the farm operator
cvr_number.notes: Stored as VARCHAR; use TRY_CAST(cvr_number AS INTEGER) when joining to cvr_enrichment_companies.

crop_code.description: Integer classification code for the registered crop (Danish: Afgkode)
crop_code.notes: Maps directly to crop_name.

crop_name.description: Danish name of the crop (e.g., 'Vinterhvede' for winter wheat, 'Brak' for fallow)
crop_name.notes: Common values include 'Vinterraps' (winter rapeseed), 'Vårbyg' (spring barley), and 'Majs' (maize).

grundbetaling_area_ha.description: Area in hectares reported for the EU Basic Payment subsidy (Danish: GBanmeldt)

grundbetaling_eligible.description: Eligibility flag for the EU Basic Payment subsidy (Danish: Grundbetaling)
grundbetaling_eligible.notes: '1' (Ja) indicates eligibility, '0' (Nej) indicates non-eligibility.

journal_number.description: Administrative reference number used by the Danish Agricultural Authority (Danish: Journalnr)
journal_number.notes: Internal reference used for case management.

block_id.description: Identifier for the administrative field block (Danish: Markblok or MB_NR)
block_id.notes: A larger spatial unit that can contain multiple individual fields.

geometry.description: Spatial field boundaries in WKB (Well-Known Binary) format (EPSG:4326)
geometry.notes: Use ST_AsText() for inspection and ST_Area() for spatial area calculations.

field_uuid.description: Deterministic, stable identifier generated from the field geometry
field_uuid.notes: Use this column for cross-year joins and time-series analysis of the same physical land plot.

municipality.description: The Danish municipality name where the field is located

is_organic.description: Boolean flag indicating if the field is certified organic or in transition
is_organic.notes: Enriched via spatial join with the official organic area register (fvm_organic_areas).

organic_conversion_date.description: The date when the field officially entered the organic conversion process

organic_deregistration_date.description: The date the field was removed from the organic register
organic_deregistration_date.notes: A null value typically indicates the field remains under organic management.

organic_conversion_status.description: Organic status code: '1' is in-conversion, '2' is fully certified organic

area_ha.description: Officially registered field area in hectares (IMK_areal)
area_ha.notes: Calculated by the Danish Agricultural Agency for EU subsidy purposes.

crop_code.notes: Maps directly to the crop_name column.

datasets.name: nles5_nitrogen_estimation_nitrogen_estimates
datasets.description: Per-field nitrogen leaching estimates calculated using the NLES5 model for environmental compliance and water quality monitoring.

field_id.description: Unique field identifier (Danish: Marknr) for a specific registration year.
field_id.notes: Stable within a single year; use field_uuid for tracking the same physical field across different years.

field_uuid.description: Deterministic UUID generated from field geometry.
field_uuid.notes: Allows for consistent tracking of the same physical field over time regardless of changing administrative IDs.

block_id.description: Field block identifier (Danish: Markblok or MB_NR) used for administrative spatial grouping.
block_id.notes: Groups multiple fields into larger units used as spatial references for EU subsidy applications.

cvr_number.description: 8-digit Danish Central Business Register (CVR) number identifying the farm or company.
cvr_number.notes: Stored as VARCHAR. Always use TRY_CAST(cvr_number AS INTEGER) when joining to reference tables like cvr_enrichment_companies.

area_ha.description: Official field area in hectares sourced from IMK_areal.
area_ha.notes: Based on the Imago-Marked registration used for official EU agricultural subsidy calculations.

crop_type.description: The name of the crop grown on the field.
crop_type.notes: Matches crop_name in gold-layer field_production tables; includes Danish specific classifications like 'Vårbyg' (Spring Barley).

soil_code.notes: Classification from JB1 (coarse sand) to JB8 (heavy clay). JB5/6 represent typical loamy soils.

soil_description.notes: Explains the JB classification in plain text (e.g., 'Medium clay soil').

nitrogen_washout_kg_ha.description: Estimated nitrogen leaching/loss to the environment.
nitrogen_washout_kg_ha.notes: Unit: Kilograms of nitrogen per hectare (kg N/ha).

percolation_mm.description: Total water drainage through the soil profile.
percolation_mm.notes: Unit: Millimeters (mm). Key input for leaching models.

percolation_april_august.description: Water percolation occurring during the growing season (April to August).
percolation_april_august.notes: Used to differentiate seasonal nutrient transport risks.

percolation_sept_march.description: Water percolation occurring during the winter period (September to March).
percolation_sept_march.notes: Typically the period with the highest leaching risk in Denmark.

uncertainty_pct.description: Model uncertainty percentage for the NLES5 estimation.
uncertainty_pct.notes: Higher values indicate lower confidence in the specific field-level calculation.

data_quality_score.description: Normalized score (0.0 to 1.0) representing the reliability of input parameters.
data_quality_score.notes: Based on the completeness and accuracy of soil and crop data used for the estimate.

geometry_wkt.description: Field boundaries represented in Well-Known Text format.
geometry_wkt.notes: Use ST_GeomFromText(geometry_wkt) for spatial analysis or ST_Area() to calculate geometry-based area.
